positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Built a data pipeline that detects anomalies in Windows OS update errors using Scope (MS query language) and C#. The data pipeline utilizes the Holt-Winters algorithm to monitor error rates.
•	Implemented a scoring metric and a bug filing system that prioritizes the anomalies using confidence interval calculation.

positions.title: Machine Learning Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a machine learning model that detects harassment in text (emails/messages).
• Built and experimented with multiple models, including logistic regression models, neural network models, and a fastText model with pre-trained word vectors.
• Models yielded high accuracy on test data (BoW: 98.9%, TF-IDF: 98.6%, LSTM: 98.4%, fastText: 98.3%) and caught 67 relevant emails from the public Enron email set (~100K emails).

positions.title: SpecTech Associate Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on migrating Spectator’s main website (100K visits/week) from JSP code to React using Styled-Components and Typescript; used GitHub, Vagrant, and Storybook for virtual collaboration.
• Followed Scrum principles in a team consisted of student developers; worked closely with product designers and journalists to publish editorials and articles; occasionally fixed bugs to maintain our website.
